messages:
maria-cs: Customer hit a 400 on POST /v1/rerank. They say payload validated on their side but our API returns `candidates must be an array`.
maria-cs: Paste of their payload (redacted):
```json
{
  "query": "best bakery near me",
  "candidates": {
    "0": {"id": "a", "text": "Bakery A"},
    "1": {"id": "b", "text": "Bakery B"}
  },
  "top_k": 3
}
```
ash-support: Do we have the exact error body returned to the client? Is it our standard schema validation error or a parsing error? cc @luis-eng
maria-cs: Error body from customer: `{"error":"400: candidates must be an array"}`. They also pasted their HTTP headers: `Content-Type: application/json`. They say they're using axios on Node.
luis-eng: This is a pretty common client-side shape bug — axios or other libs sometimes send objects with numeric string keys when code builds a map and then `JSON.stringify` keeps it as object. Our schema validator expects an array. If the JSON parsed fine, it's exactly that: `candidates` is an object, not an array.
ash-support: Can we improve error message to say "candidates must be a JSON array of objects (got object)"? Right now it's ambiguous for customers.
luis-eng: I'll add a clearer validation error on the service side (small change). Also can add preflight detection that suggests converting object->array in the error hint.
devex-soph: For support reply, suggest this quick client-side fix for axios users: `const payload = { query, candidates: Object.values(candidatesMap), top_k }; axios.post(url, payload)` — converts keyed map into array.
rerank-bot: [auto] linked ticket #12345; traced to client sending a map for candidates. Suggested doc page: https://docs.redwood.ai/api/rerank#request-format
ash-support: Forwarded suggested fix + example to customer. Asked them to try converting to array and re-test.
maria-cs: Customer tried Object.values(...) fix and reports success. They no longer get 400. ":tada:" 
ash-support: Filing small backend change PR to make error friendlier and include hint. I'll link PR once open.
luis-eng: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/service/pull/432 (adds hint when candidates is object). Marking this as resolved on our side after PR merges.
maria-cs: Closing thread, customer satisfied. :white_check_mark:
